slides.title: A drill, like a fire drill
slides.text: Defenders practice what to do when something online goes wrong, the way schools practice a fire drill. Calm, practiced moves beat panicked clever ones, every time.
slides.alt: Lock 5, Five Moves: a message unkind to Sam is going around the class chat. Five move tiles wait to be put in order.

focus.cue: The five moves, like a fire drill

slides.title: Stop, then save it
slides.text: Move one is Stop: hands off, do not reply, and do not delete in a panic. Move two is Save it: keep the message or a picture of it, because it is proof of what happened.
slides.alt: Two moves placed in order: Stop, do not pass it on, then Save it, keep the message.

slides.title: Tell an adult
slides.text: Move three is Tell an adult: a trusted adult at home or at school. If the first adult does not act, tell another. Telling fast is protection, never shame, and never your fault.
slides.alt: Four moves in order: Stop, Save it, Tell a trusted adult, Block or report. Carry on is the last tile.

focus.cue: Move three: Tell a trusted adult

slides.title: Block or report
slides.text: Move four is Block or report, using the buttons in the app, always with a trusted adult beside you in real life. Move five is Carry on: the worry is handed over, and you go back to your day.
slides.alt: NewFriend's chat with both clues found, and the four moves below it: Deliver, Bin it, Show Pim, Report and block.

focus.cue: Block or report: a button, pressed with an adult

slides.title: The five moves in order
slides.text: A fake page just asked for a player's mailbox key, and the player typed it. Put the Defender moves in order.
steps: Stop: hands off the fake page
Save it: keep a picture of the page
Carry on while adults change the key

slides.title: Speed is protection
slides.text: If you ever type something private into a trick page, telling fast is what saves you. Adults can change the key before the trickster uses it, so every minute of honesty helps.

words.means: to tell the app and an adult that something broke the rules
to stop someone from messaging you
proof of what happened, like a saved message
a grown person you know and can rely on for help

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Trick Inbox and play the Boss Round. Before each message, say the five moves quietly, then choose your response.
slides.alt: Trick Inbox, the Boss Round: a stranger's game chat waits in the inbox, one clue found in green and one still hiding.

focus.cue: Play the Boss Round: say the five moves first
